title: LLM isolation: each evolve dispatch verb needs a dispatch credential that no cell receives
summary: The X4 phase markers are advisory: env -u EVOLVE_DISPATCH_DEPTH -u EVOLVE_PHASE evolve agent run passes the refusal (review of #1126, 2026-10-26). subagent run checks only its depth cap, and phase, loop and wave next read no marker. The sandbox cannot deny the evolve binary, because profiles run evolve phase verify. Row N4 proves the advisory layer only. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §7.1, §7.2.
fix: The pipeline writes a 0600 dispatch credential (a token file or a socket) in its private run dir. The dispatch verbs agent run, phase <name> run, subagent run, loop and wave next refuse when the credential is missing, whatever the env markers say. The cell sandbox denies the read of that path (SBPL deny and bwrap mask), and the X2 hermetic env keeps it out of the child env.
acceptance: A cell with the markers unset still cannot run evolve agent run, subagent run, phase run, loop or wave next
A contract row: a cell cannot read the credential path
Pipeline-started dispatches and fan-out workers still run
Changed functions at 100% coverage on every CI OS; spec §7.1 and §7.2 updated
source: console, 2026-10-26, independent review of #1126 (MEDIUM-2); see docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §7.2
